verdict.rationale: RevenueCat offers webhooks for real-time event notifications (revenuecat-gh-3) that can be wired to trigger external actions, but there's no built-in rule engine to define conditional logic or automated actions natively within RevenueCat itself. A community feature request explicitly asks for 'timed hooks' like trial-expiry reminders, indicating this kind of automation isn't natively supported (revenuecat-comm-6). Missing for 10: native rule/trigger builder, conditional logic definitions, in-product automated actions beyond raw webhook delivery.
